messages:
maya_cs: Quick heads-up — Nimbus (acct NIM-001) renewal in ~30 days. We promised Dedicated capacity + autoscale. Final bring-up rehearsal scheduled Wed 03:00 PDT. Goals: validate reserved quota, exercise autoscale end-to-end, capture latency and cost deltas, and run a short enablement + feedback session.

sam_eng: I can own quota priming and verify autoscale policy. What traffic profile are we aiming for?

maya_cs: Prod-ish: sustained ~120 QPS, avg payload ~512 tokens, with 4-6% long requests ~2k tokens. Desired headroom = 30% to avoid premature upsell flag.

leo_oncall: I'll watch SLOs, cache warmup, and mem pressure. Add me to the run's pager hooks.

olivia_pm: I'll run a 30m enablement walkthrough and a 6-question feedback survey. Will share the draft today.

maya_cs: Quick checklist:
- reserved quota: 8 GPUs (pool rdx-gpu-a1)
- autoscale policy: min=4, target_util=0.65, max=12
- warmup: 2x prefix priming, 15m each
- run pattern: 20m steady + two 3m spike windows
- metrics: tokens/sec, p95 latency, error rate, OOMs, cost/token

sam_eng: I'll push the policy to staging and run a dry replay. k6 snippet for steady load:
```js
import http from 'k6/http';
import { sleep } from 'k6';
export default function () {
  http.post('https://loadproxy.internal/replay', JSON.stringify({qps:120, tokens:512}));
  sleep(0.008);
}
```

jen_devex: If you want a replay of their traces I can convert anonymized traces into our format; ETA a couple hours.

opsbot: Scheduled job created: id=job-2026-05-06-10; window=2026-05-06T10:00:00Z; owner=sam_eng. Alerts posting to #eng-oncall.

leo_oncall: Subscribed to job-2026-05-06-10. Please confirm model/version and fallback policy. I'll add a temporary Grafana panel.

maya_cs: Model pinned to `rw-instruct-3b-v2`. Fallback = `rw-instruct-3b-quant` on mem pressure.

sam_eng: Canary plan during the run: shift 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 15m if p95 < 600ms and error < 0.5%. I'll add rollback steps.

olivia_pm: Survey draft uploaded to drive: 6 short Qs on latency sensitivity, acceptable error rate, and docs clarity.

maya_cs: Action items & owners:
- sam_eng: push autoscale + staging dry run (due Tue 18:00 PDT)
- jen_devex: trace conversion + handoff script (due Tue 20:00 PDT)
- leo_oncall: dashboards + pager wires (due Wed 01:00 PDT)
- olivia_pm: enablement deck + survey (due Tue EOD)
- maya_cs: final runbook + renewal note to account thread (I'll send)

maya_cs: React with :thumbsup: when you take ownership so I can tick off the checklist.

sam_eng: :thumbsup: taking autoscale + replay.

jen_devex: :thumbsup: starting trace conversion now.

leo_oncall: :thumbsup: will add alert rules and dashboard panels.

olivia_pm: :thumbsup: will share the agenda by EOD.
